entries.back_en: You didn't get hurt, did you? Sorry. I didn't tell you about my wings... I can use them to fly a little, so I can survive a fall like that.
...And that's how I ended up here. Where are you heading,
...... See? It's easy, isn't it? One more to go.
entries.note: 'Mais um para ir' é literal/estranho; usar 'Falta mais um.'
